description: This file contains unit tests for the ModifyFeatureStrategy class, verifying its behavior when modifying features within a 'Thing' object in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It uses JUnit for testing and focuses on immutability, handling of non-existent features, and updating existing features.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ModifyFeatureStrategy, testing immutability and feature modification scenarios.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture with a modified feature instance before all tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test case.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ModifyFeatureStrategy class instances are immutable.

methods.name: modifyFeatureOnThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Tests modification of a feature on a Thing that initially has no features.

methods.name: modifyFeatureOnThingWithoutThatFeature
methods.description: Tests modification of a feature not initially present on the Thing.

methods.name: modifyExistingFeature
methods.description: Tests modification of an existing feature on the Thing.
